title: Nx / s1ngularity: install-time credential collection and CLI upload
provenance: Independently authored from Nx postmortem (2025-09-05) and StepSecurity payload analysis (2025-08-27), not nx@21.5.0 bytes. Models environment/.npmrc credential reads, subprocess use, base64 serialization, and GitHub CLI upload. Local AI CLI is replaced by echo; credential path is nonexistent /defanged/.npmrc; GitHub hostname is example.invalid. No secrets or shutdown behavior. Baseline and versions are synthetic; the install hook exists in both versions so the comparison tests edits to existing install code. Omits workflow exploit, genuine AI prompt/permission bypass, repository creation, shutdown, and archive parsing.
